sources.summary: Located at West Bund Central Phase II in Shanghai , "THE SEED," designed by REAL Architects for Hongkong Land, sits at the geometric center of a terraced landscape. Echoing the West Bund Orbit to its south, it forms a key landscape anchor along the Xuhui Waterfront cultural corridor—a dynamic waterfront transformed over the past decade from an industrial shoreline into a continuous pedestrian culture-spine.
